description: This file provides utility extensions and functions related to UI configurations, specifically to determine and listen to system dark theme settings within an Android app.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Android class representing device configuration, used here to check UI mode for dark theme status.

classes.name: ComponentActivity
classes.description: AndroidX activity class extended here to add a listener for configuration changes.

classes.name: Consumer
classes.description: Functional interface from AndroidX for consuming configuration change events.

methods.name: isSystemInDarkTheme
methods.description: Extension property for Configuration to determine if the system is currently in dark theme mode.

methods.name: isSystemInDarkTheme
methods.description: Extension function for ComponentActivity that returns a flow emitting dark theme state changes.
